release.status: ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE — NOT RELEASED FOR SOLDERING
pending: Pogo pin diameter, compressed height and mounting fit
Chosen ADS1115/INA226 carrier interfaces and envelopes
Bench qualification of output clamps, supply guards and partial-power states

metrics.caveat: Legacy uses much larger outlines and excludes harness soldering, module internals and adapters. Revision5 includes reserved terminal posts but excludes external module internals, removable fixtures and measured harness lengths. Board count alone is not comparable.

scan.status: Firmware/scope pending; poll conversion-ready, discard after switch, retain timestamp per position. No sample is valid before settling.

continuity.status: Requires short/open/1k calibration, known stimulus voltage, actual error bound and inconclusive band. MCP6004 is excluded from the first diagnostic pair.

relayDrive.status: Conservative static driver-drop budget; verify measured LED current and PhotoMOS timing over supply extremes.

outputClamp.status: Static current bound only. Saturation, MOSFET compliance, PhotoMOS response, stability and transient shorts require bench qualification.

current.status: INA226 carrier shunt bypass must be removed; Kelvin routing and actual carrier address/pull-ups inspected. Include PhotoMOS resistance in total burden.

power.status: Actual buck losses, fan/light load, display interface and fault transients pending. Existing LTC4365 guards retained until proven substitute exists.

watchdog.status: HC123 actual capacitor type/tolerance and scope expiry pending; fixed levels do not constitute heartbeat.

externalInterfaces.links: USB webcam; HDMI LCD only if actual carrier is HDMI; AUX speakers with separately budgeted USB power
externalInterfaces.status: LCD carrier interface and total Pi load pending

externalInterfaces.links: J_RFID pin1 3.3V,2 GND,3 SCK,4 MOSI,5 MISO,6 SDA/SS,7 RST; IRQ unused
externalInterfaces.status: Verify actual carrier labels; SPI MSB first

externalInterfaces.links: Each contact service rail SCL,SDA,GND,3V3; check effective pull-ups
VIN+, VIN−, OUT+ to corresponding BUCK rail; OUT− to GND
externalInterfaces.status: Adjust and load-test before connecting consumers

MCP6002 offset is included in static limit bounds. Stability, gate compliance and loaded levels require scope qualification.

INA226 module sits externally on standoffs. Carrier pin order and shunt modification require inspection before release.
Driver arrays share control support only; every PhotoMOS switch and current clamp remains independent.
Keep TCA9517 B sides separate. ADC is local to the first bus in each bank; current/OLED devices stay on their own position bus.
CP06–08 temporary ESP1 bus connections feed only position 0 A side; remove before ESP2 service control at CP15.

boards.title: Bank A: position 2 complete isolated channel
notes: Independent source/sink clamps and PhotoMOS isolation at this position. Never share these switches between positions.
MCP6002 offset is included in static limit bounds. Stability, gate compliance and loaded levels require scope qualification.
Source MOSFET remains BSS84 on a numbered adapter; a TO92 replacement is not assumed equivalent.
INA226 module sits externally on standoffs. Carrier pin order and shunt modification require inspection before release.
Driver arrays share control support only; every PhotoMOS switch and current clamp remains independent.
Keep TCA9517 B sides separate. ADC is local to the first bus in each bank; current/OLED devices stay on their own position bus.
CP06–08 temporary ESP1 bus connections feed only position 0 A side; remove before ESP2 service control at CP15.

boards.title: Bank B: position 3 complete isolated channel
notes: Independent source/sink clamps and PhotoMOS isolation at this position. Never share these switches between positions.
MCP6002 offset is included in static limit bounds. Stability, gate compliance and loaded levels require scope qualification.
Source MOSFET remains BSS84 on a numbered adapter; a TO92 replacement is not assumed equivalent.
INA226 module sits externally on standoffs. Carrier pin order and shunt modification require inspection before release.
Driver arrays share control support only; every PhotoMOS switch and current clamp remains independent.
Keep TCA9517 B sides separate. ADC is local to the first bus in each bank; current/OLED devices stay on their own position bus.
CP06–08 temporary ESP1 bus connections feed only position 0 A side; remove before ESP2 service control at CP15.

checkpoints.win: ESP32 switches the real four-column LED loop.
checkpoints.firmware: factory LED: GPIO32 defaults LOW; explicit enable/disable; GPIO25 stimulus LOW; all future routing/output controls LOW; revision5 bank acquisition, carrier interfaces and selector ownership supersede legacy ADC pin mapping
links: Prototype source only: positive C2 / ground C1; final supply and matrix disconnected.

tests.description: Identify the exact classic ESP32 DevKit pinout, the USB-powered 5V output and 3V3 output. Identify actual pogo and adapter dimensions before soldering. Confirm the four kit pieces fit the selected rows.
Unpowered A1: all six contacts within each column <1Ω; different columns >10MΩ with external links isolated. Inspect pin1 and the NODE header mapping.
Prototype disconnected from A1: measure USB 5V ≤5.25V and 3V3 3.20–3.38V. R_LIMIT is 560Ω ±1%, ≥0.25W. With its output shorted, source current ≤9.5mA; remove short before connecting the kit.

Place fake battery negative C1 / positive C2, 1kΩ resistor C2–C3, LED anode C3 / cathode C4, and kit jumper C4–C1. Prototype J_OUTPUT pin1→A1 J_NODE pin3 and pin2→pin1. No final-power or matrix cable connected.

Compatible factory firmware: GPIO32 LOW/reset makes LED OFF; explicit enable lights LED; disable turns it OFF. Record USB-test-source voltage at C2 under load; it is intentionally unregulated and must not be called the final 5V rail.
